section_anchor: Seasonal colorways are a recurring, minor tracker category
brief_summary: Four-swatch glyph strip breaking down GMK CYL Zombie's named colorway rows: charcoal base row, pumpkin-orange alpha row, zombie-green accent/modifier row, and a bone-white novelties row illustrated with a small stitched-grin icon. Each swatch is labeled with its row name and color description as given in the article's own description of the set.
data_sources: gmk-cyl-zombie-group-buy.mdx § 'What's in the set' — 'The base row leans into a near-black charcoal, with a pumpkin-orange alpha set carrying most of the legend contrast. The accent and modifier rows shift into a sickly zombie-green...the novelties row leans on the genre's standard iconography: stitched grins, tombstones, a bandaged or bitten-looking Esc cap.'
